description: A shell script for testing two-way merge scenarios with 'git read-tree -m', including setup, various merge cases, and validation of merge behaviors in a Git repository.

methods.name: read_tree_twoway
methods.description: Performs a two-way merge using 'git read-tree -m' and lists staged files.

methods.name: compare_change
methods.description: Compares the current file against expected output, filtering diff output.

methods.name: check_cache_at
methods.description: Checks the cache state of a file, indicating clean or dirty.
